[[File:BCM.png|thumb|300px|Diagram of a [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] behavioral circuitry matrix]]
The '''behavioral circuitry matrix''' was the combined mechanical and neutronic subsystems that produced [[Droid/Legends|droid]] behavior. The matrix was split into two modules&mdash;the [[obedience-rational module]] and the [[sensory-response module]]. The obedience-rational module governed the logical and social behavior of the droid while the sensory-response module controlled the droid's systems<ref name="GSWU">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]''</ref> including [[audio-visual circuit]]s, an [[olfactory-speech center]], a [[Gyro-balance circuitry|gyro-balance unit]], a [[spectrum analysis unit]], and an [[extremity control system]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|67|behavioral circuitry matrix}}</ref> The [[behavioral chip]]s of several upper-end droid models were built using [[Vonium/Legends|Vonium]], a precious metal.<ref name="sj">{{GamerCite|2|Snow Job}}</ref>
